paragraphs: Fortem Technologies builds radar systems and autonomous drones that guard airspace for military and civilian operations. The work spans C-UAS, ISR, perimeter security, airspace safety, and several emerging airborne markets.

Three product families make up the SkyDome System: TrueView sensors, DroneHunter interceptors, and SkyDome Manager software. The DroneHunter F700 performs mid-air captures autonomously, with a stated 85% success rate. SkyDome Manager is the airspace monitoring and counter-UAS command and control software behind those sensors.

Buyers described on the site include airports, treated as a target for drone-based attacks. Law enforcement agencies are another, as criminals begin using store-bought drones to commit serious felonies. Backers named by the company include Lockheed Martin, Toshiba, Boeing, DCVC, and Signia Venture Partners.

quote.text: Fortem Technologies is the leader in airspace awareness, security, and defense for detecting and defeating dangerous drones.
